body: After spending three years behind bars, one man finally received the news he had been waiting for — his case had been dismissed. The emotional moment was captured on video as his lawyer delivered the news. At first, he appeared to be in complete disbelief before realizing he could finally be going home. After years of uncertainty and being separated from life outside, his reaction showed just how much the moment meant to him.
